CHECK-IN & CANCELLATION POLICY
Prices are subject to change and rooms are subject to availability.
Check-in time from 14h00
Check-out time from 10h00
Cancellation Policy
50% deposit is required on the day of the booking or when booking is confirmed
If cancelled up to 30 days prior to arrival no deposit fee will be charged
If cancelled later than 30 days and up to 7 days 50% of the total stay will be charged
If cancelled later than 7 days prior to arrival up to 100% can be charged
In the unfortunate event of a no show, 100% will be charged on a confirmed booking
Refunds on deposits are at the discretion of the management and are dependent on the
ability to re‐sell the room.
